g.text: K3: TMA loads with an mbarrier pipeline (one KV stage vs five)
full barrier fires after K_j and V_j bytes land (red). Consumers release the slot (green) before the next load can start: no overlap.
five loads are issued up front; each released slot is refilled with tile j + 5 (dashed). The TMA unit works while the threads compute.
the TMA unit arrives with bytes, consumers wait on the phase
consumers arrive after P V, the producer waits before refilling
SMEM per CTA at d = 128: sQ 16 KB + kv_stage x 32 KB (K and V get separate buffers now) + sS 16 KB: 64 KB at 1 stage, 192 KB at 5.
